prompt:

Row 1: front-three-quarter oval HEAD facing right with both vertical eyes; same head slight profile right; head determined eyes angled; head hurt eyes tightly closed.
Row 2: ROUND TORSO with small black oval socket at its top; right facing pink MITTEN FIST side view; left facing pink MITTEN FIST side view; compact round pink FIST knuckles toward viewer.
Row 3: right-facing flattened OVAL FOOT side view; left-facing flattened oval foot side view; upright sole pink oval foot; round pink open MITTEN PALM.
Keep head approximately 65% of cell width and 40% height, torso 45% width/height, fists 40% width/height, feet 50% width and 26% height. Transparent background with real alpha. Uniform character design, outlines and material. No full assembled figure anywhere. High-quality clean game sprite art.
